bias.en: Bearish, improving · SAR turned bullish, testing the 30-day
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · SAR 转多，测试 30 日均线

read.en: Marvell rose 3.3% on Oct 28 to $251.65, trading between $246.22 and $253.66 on 0.6 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($236.20), 10-day ($237.23) and 100-day ($239.80) and the rising 200-day ($181.94), and just below the rising 30-day ($255.05). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Oct 28 ($220.21), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: Marvell 10月28日上涨 3.3%，收于 $251.65，盘中区间 $246.22–253.66，成交量为均量的 0.6 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$236.20）、10 日（$237.23）和 100 日均线（$239.80）以及上行的 200 日均线（$181.94）上方，略低于上行的 30 日均线（$255.05）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 10月28日转为看多（$220.21），RSI 为 52。

read.en: The close cleared $246–250.1 (old SAR, Oct 21 high), now support, and flipped the SAR bullish; the high stopped under the 30-day. Resistance is $253.7–255.1 (Oct 28 high, 30-day), then $264.3 (Oct 14 high) and $269.1 (Oct 13 high). Support is $246.2–250.1, then $236.2–239.8 (5, 10 and 100-day) and $220.2 (SAR, Oct 22 low). A close above $255.1 would target $264–269; below $246, $240.
